stem.text: A nucleus of neptunium-236 contains 93 protons and 143 neutrons. This nucleus decays with the emission of an $\alpha$-particle. The nucleus formed then emits a $\beta^{-}$ particle.
Which diagram shows the changes in the number $P$ of protons and the number $N$ of neutrons in these nuclei?

A.alt: Grid graph with horizontal axis labelled P from 90 to 96 and vertical axis labelled N from 138 to 146, with a sequence of arrows drawn on the grid.

B.alt: Grid graph with horizontal axis labelled P from 90 to 96 and vertical axis labelled N from 138 to 146, with a sequence of arrows drawn on the grid.

C.alt: Grid graph with horizontal axis labelled P from 90 to 96 and vertical axis labelled N from 138 to 146, with a sequence of arrows drawn on the grid.
